FROST_FANG.title: Ambusher
FROST_FANG.description: Right-click to toggle between normal form and Ambush form. While in Ambush form, cards you play go into the Ambush zone; in normal form, playing a card brings out the oldest card in your Ambush zone.
FROST_FANG.flavor: “Lurk in the dark, and wait for the moment.”
ASSASSIN.title: Assassin
ASSASSIN.description: Right-click to toggle between normal form and Ambush form. While in Ambush form, cards you play go into the Ambush zone; in normal form, playing a card brings out the oldest card in your Ambush zone. Your [gold]Ambush zone[/gold] capacity is increased by [blue]1[/blue]. At the start of your turn, you may add a card from your hand into your [gold]Ambush zone[/gold].
ASSASSIN.flavor: You have already mastered the tricks of the hunt.
ASSASSIN.selectionScreenPrompt: Select a card to add into your [gold]Ambush zone[/gold].
